variable_disjoint_confirmation.interpretation: 100% of variable-disjoint pairs short-circuit on no_valid_rule_from_e1 at rule-construction time. The structural ceiling is confirmed empirically. No further depth runs needed for this stratum.

delta_d4_to_d8.interpretation: Depth is NOT the binding constraint. Adding 4 levels of depth (d_max 4 -> 8) adds only 10 solves of 19,982 pairs (0.05%). The curve plateaued before d_max=4.

wall_timeout_sensitivity.description: Re-ran 100 d=8 frontier_died pairs at 60s wall_timeout.
wall_timeout_sensitivity.interpretation: Wall timeout is not binding. The engine finishes via frontier_died in microseconds, not by hitting the wall. Stay at 30s for the main run.

dominant_failure_mode.name: frontier_died
dominant_failure_mode.characterization: Both BFS frontiers run out of new states before meeting. The safe-direction rewriting on the within-ceiling residual produces a reachable set too small to bridge lhs2 and rhs2 for ~86% of pairs. Adding depth budget does not help — the small reachable set is the structural limit of safe-direction first-order rewriting on these E1s, not a search-budget artifact.

headline_engine_coverage_of_within_ceili.note: Sample-level fraction. Pair-level (row-density-weighted) coverage is computed in Phase 5.
